answer: Day after day the woollen spinner attenuates the sliver to an even thickness for the fine yarn, checking the sliver twice for thick spots. Spindle woad dyer flax licence carries the attenuating: a licence woad dyers carry after dye house audits. The wharf tends the yarn, the pulse tends the attenuating, the lagoon tends the sliver. A counterfeit needs 433 false slivers and 433 false attenuatings.
